exposure: peri-operative echocardiographic assessments of right ventricular function
peri-operative echocardiographic assessments of pulmonary hypertension
cohort: Thirty-one late preterm and term infants with left Bochdalek's hernia (LBH) not accompanied by congenital heart disease were included.
finding: Peri-operative functional echocardiography provided information about the evolution of cardiac function, and significant correlations were noted between pre-operative assessments and the duration of respiratory support in infants with left Bochdalek's hernia.
